description: This file defines a TypeScript module for configuring a CLI backend plugin for the Google Gemini AI model within an OpenClaw extension. It exports a function to build and return the plugin configuration object, including command-line arguments, model aliases, session management, and watchdog settings.

methods.name: export function buildGoogleGeminiCliBackend(): CliBackendPlugin { buildGoogleGeminiCliBackend
methods.description: Constructs and returns a CliBackendPlugin object configured for the Google Gemini model, including command details, model aliases, session parameters, and watchdog configurations.
